CustomerReview.title: CustomerReview
CustomerReview.description: Genuine customer feedback or farm visit review submitted for Kadaknath Poultry Farm

authorName.description: Name of the customer or farm visitor

location.description: Village, town, or city of the reviewer

purchaseCategory.description: Product ordered or type of visit

status.description: Visibility status of the customer feedback

helpfulCount.description: Number of visitors who found this feedback helpful

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID if submitted by a signed-in Google user, or empty string

verifiedAccount.description: Whether the feedback was submitted by a verified Google account

ownerReply.description: Optional official response posted by the farm owner

ownerRepliedAt.description: Optional server timestamp of the farm owner's response

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the feedback was submitted

CustomerEnquiry.title: CustomerEnquiry
CustomerEnquiry.description: Customer enquiry submitted from the farm contact section

name.description: Full name of the enquiring customer

message.description: Enquiry details regarding Kadaknath birds, chicks, or eggs

status.description: Follow-up status managed by the farm owner

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the enquiry was submitted

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Verified farm owner account record for feedback and enquiry management

role.description: Role within the farm admin panel

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin document was created

FarmSettings.title: FarmSettings
FarmSettings.description: Public farm contact details managed by the owner

phoneDisplay.description: Formatted phone number displayed on the site

whatsappDigits.description: Digits-only WhatsApp number with country code

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Live customer feedback and verified owner responses for Kadaknath Poultry Farm

/enquiries/{enquiryId}.description: Customer product and farm visit enquiries readable strictly by the verified farm owner

/admins/{userId}.description: Owner authorization records for feedback and enquiry management

/settings/{settingId}.description: Public contact configuration editable by the verified owner
